  Problem: 38 lines in the Python heredoc embedded in the "Append review pipeline iteration summary" step carry trailing whitespace. Confirmed via cat -A inspection showing " $" patterns on blank lines between function definitions inside the heredoc.
  Why it fails at runtime: The CI lint job runs yamllint -s against .github/workflows/*.yml and reports [trailing-spaces] as errors. The lint check-run on this PR head shows conclusion=failure with these exact 38 line numbers, which blocks the merge gate.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4173-4176
  Problem: The retry_extended branch in reviewer_plan_retry_after_retryable_failure() is effectively dead code under the default retry budget. The guard requires slot_fallback_model_used=true AND slot_retryable_failure_count < reviewer_slot_retry_limit AND next_attempt_number <= reviewer_max_attempts. With both reviewer_slot_retry_limit and reviewer_max_attempts defaulting to 3, after the failback attempt (attempt 3), next_attempt_number would be 4 while slot_retryable_failure_count would be 3, so the condition never becomes true.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure — the branch simply never executes under defaults. It only becomes reachable if an operator raises reviewer_slot_retry_limit above reviewer_max_attempts.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:728, 744
  Problem: The resume-skip checks for floor_rules and consolidator both use autofix_resume_can_reuse_stage "consolidator" as the scope name, even though floor_rules is a semantically distinct stage. Line 728 checks FLOOR_TAGS_FILE with scope "consolidator", and line 744 checks CONSOLIDATOR_RAW_FILE with the same scope label.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure — the file-existence checks on FLOOR_TAGS_FILE and CONSOLIDATOR_RAW_FILE are the actual gatekeepers. The scope name is cosmetic for log output ("Resume: reusing cached ... from same-head partial state"), but misleads operators reading logs about which stage was reused.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:111-122
  Problem: The partial-finalize git clean -ffdx exclusion list includes .ai, .serena, scripts, prompts, .github/ai, .github/scripts, .github/prompts, .codex-workflow-src, and .codex-workflow-src-main, but omits prompts/_templates. If future transient template artifacts are generated under prompts/_templates/ during the reviewer/editor phase, the partial-finalize cleanup would silently discard them while the Serena cleanup preserves the full prompts/ tree.
  Why it fails at runtime: No current failure — prompts/_templates is not a directory that transient artifacts land in today. This is a forward-looking gap that would surface if future editor or summarizer logic starts writing scratch templates there.
